extracted.intended_audience: general readers; students of American history and literature; readers of autobiographical slave narratives
extracted.subtask_description: Producing or analyzing first-person, 19th-century autobiographical slave narratives that recount kidnapping, captivity, and escape, with emphasis on realistic detail, moral appeal, and chronological episodic structure. Useful for writers learning to render historical scenes, character suffering, and procedural events in immersive prose.
